title: Could Be Wider
text: Could Be Wider. This is needs to be extra large in the width to carry anything more than a few sandwiches. Any container that may have leftovers or things like that would have be turned on it's side or else placed right in the very center of the bag which doesn't allow for it to be closed.  Disappointing.
